0022600213.text: The LA Clippers (2-7, 0-4 on the road) come into this game 13th in the West and 6 games back in the Pacific, on a one-game winning streak, while the Phoenix Suns (3-5, 3-2 at home) are 12th in the West and 4.5 games back in the Pacific, riding a two-game winning streak. The Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), and Cam Christie is day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision, while the Suns are without Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Mark Williams (shoulder surgery). The two teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and they split their 2025-26 series 2-2, with the Clippers winning the last meeting 117-93 in Phoenix on February 1, 2026.
